attchmntText: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Patanjali Foods Limited has executed addendums to its Principal Agreements with Patanjali Ayurved Limited. The addendums extend the closing period for completion of formalities by six months. The Principal Agreements include the Agreement To Transfer Leasehold Rights and the Plant and Machinery Transfer Agreement. These were originally executed on March 14, 2026. The addendums were signed on November 14, 2026. All other terms and conditions of the Principal Agreements remain unchanged. The extension applies to the acquisition of leasehold rights and the purchase of biscuit manufacturing plant and machinery. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Patanjali Foods Limited has entered into an agreement with promoter group company Patanjali Ayurved Limited to transfer leasehold rights and interest in two parcels of land located at Sector 3, Industrial Growth Centre, Pithampur, District Dhar, Madhya Pradesh. The transaction value is Rs. 185 Crore, with transfer charges borne by Patanjali Foods Limited. Patanjali Ayurved Limited holds a 29.60% shareholding in the entity. The agreement is classified as a related party transaction conducted at arm's length. The current document serves as an agreement to transfer and does not effect the immediate assignment of leasehold rights. The actual transfer will occur upon the execution and registration of a revised Lease Deed with Madhya Pradesh Audyogik Kendra Vikas Nigam (Indore) Limited. No special rights regarding director appointments or capital structure changes are envisaged under this agreement.

attchmntText: Patanjali Foods Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited Standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Patanjali Foods Limited reported unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 14, 2026. Statutory auditor Walker Chandiok & Co. LLP issued a Limited Review Report with an unmodified opinion. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 22,66,003.39 lakh. Profit after tax stood at 75,565.41 lakh. Earnings per share were 6.95. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 11,32,258.27 lakh. Profit after tax was 41,979.77 lakh. Earnings per share were 3.86. The company operates in edible oils, FMCG, and wind turbine power generation segments.

attchmntText: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Patanjali Foods Limited invites analysts and investors to an earnings call on Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 3:00 PM IST. The call will discuss operational and financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Participants include Chief Executive Officer Sanjeev Asthana, Chief Financial Officer Kumar Rajesh, and Investor Relations representative Priyendu Jha. The company confirms that no price-sensitive information or forward-looking statements will be disclosed during the session. Dial-in numbers for India and international locations are provided for participation. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. Details are available on the company website at www.patanjalifoods.com.
